messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: Paging infra-oncall: GPU pool exhausted in prod us-west-2, queue growth > 1200 requests/min. Severity: P1

mira.kapoor: seeing huge request pile on /generate, 503s turning into 429s at the gateway. Dashboards show token service backlog growing since 22:12 UTC.

samuel.cho: confirmed - queue length spike correlates with batch jobs from customer 'zephyr'. Noticing autoscaler failing to add nodes, logs show launch template mismatch errors.

kevin.li: looking at the cluster-autoscaler logs:
```
W1106 22:14:03.123456 1 scale_up.go:xxx Could not scale up: failed to launch nodegroup gpu-nodes: error creating instance: InvalidLaunchTemplate: Launch template version 999 not found
caused by: instance profile arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-role missing
```

jen.walsh: oh — we rolled a new launch template last night as part of a non-gpu infra change. Did someone rotate instance profile permissions?

mira.kapoor: @infra-oncall can you validate instance profile & iam role for gpu nodegroup? If CA can't create nodes, we need manual fallback.

infra-oncall: investigating. I can see ASG attempts to scale but AWS returns 400 for launch template version. Quick check: the launch-template id matches, but the default version points to a template that references an instance profile that was deleted in the last rotation.

samuel.cho: that explains the 'instance profile missing' error. CA keeps trying compatible nodegroups but AWS rejects. Also seeing kubelet taint mismatch error when some nodes do come up: taint `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` present on nodepool which our pods don't tolerate.

kevin.li: posting relevant kube events snippet: 
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m    default-scheduler  0/30 nodes are available: 30 node(s) didn't match node selector, 30 taints match NoSchedule.
```

mira.kapoor: customer impact: several production inference endpoints degraded. SLO alerts firing (p95 latency > 4s, errors elevated). Not seeing data plane data corruption. Need to notify affected accounts and open support ticket.

pagerduty-bot: escalation: paging sre oncall + oncall-manager.

jen.walsh: handoff plan: infra-oncall will fix IAM/launch-template, kevin will patch CA config to ignore deprecated LT version temporarily, sam will remove the extra taint on new nodes or add tolerations in our daemonset, mira will coordinate customer comms.

infra-oncall: working now — recreating instance-profile and reattaching `redwood-gpu-role`. Also updating launch template default version to the last known-good JSON. ETA 20m.

kevin.li: while that's in flight, I'm going to apply a temporary CA override: `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false --balance-similar-node-groups` (so it favors other pools) and bump scale-down delay to 10m to avoid thrash.

samuel.cho: I'll run a quick job to add tolerations on the GPU workload deployment so existing nodes accept pods until we get stable nodes:
```
kubectl -n prod patch deployment gpu-workers -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"dedicated","operator":"Equal","value":"gpu","effect":"NoSchedule","tolerationSeconds":3600}]}}}}'
```

mira.kapoor: drafting customer note: "We're investigating a capacity issue causing intermittent failures for inference endpoints in us-west-2. We're applying mitigations and will follow up with timeline and root cause." Will post to status soon.

infra-oncall: instance profile recreated and attached. Launch template default version set to v42. I triggered a manual ASG increase to add 6 nodes to buy time: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-prod-asg --desired-capacity 18`

deploy-bot: ASG desired capacity updated to 18 (requested by infra-oncall). Scaling activity started.

kevin.li: CA detected the new instances coming up; however kube-proxy image mismatch prevented some nodes from registering. Logs:
```
E1106 22:40:12.987 kubelet.go:failed Kubelet version mismatch: couldn't register node
```

samuel.cho: I see 4 new nodes Ready, 2 NotReady. Removing the stray taint on the problematic nodes now:
```
kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-7 dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule- --overwrite
kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-9 dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule- --overwrite
```

jen.walsh: after taint removal and tolerations patch, pods are scheduling onto new nodes and queue drained ~70% in last 8 minutes. Gateway errors dropping.

mira.kapoor: posting initial incident message to status.redwood.com and pinging affected CSMs. Noting that this is ongoing P1.

infra-oncall: follow-up: launch template audit shows last change removed instance profile reference accidentally while copying metadata. Will create PR to lock LT changes and add a pre-deploy check.

kevin.li: created a temporary CA deploy with `--expander=least-waste` and lowered the node-provisioning retry window to avoid repeat failures. We'll revert after stability.

pagerduty-bot: oncall-manager acknowledged.

mira.kapoor: customer update posted: "Mitigations in place. Capacity added and autoscaler fix in progress. We are monitoring. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner."

samuel.cho: metrics: queue drained to baseline in ~22 minutes after manual ASG bump + taint fix. We'll keep ASG at +6 for 2 hours and then scale back once autoscaler is healthy.

infra-oncall: created PR #4221 with LT preflight check in CI and new IAM detection script. Assigning to @jen.walsh for review.

jen.walsh: reviewing now, will merge after one more test. Also scheduling a short postmortem meeting in 48h.

mira.kapoor: action items captured: 1) restore LT guardrails (infra) 2) improve CA visibility (sre) 3) add e2e test to validate instance profile existence before deploy (devex) 4) customer follow-up and RCA (product).

kevin.li: adding one more ops note: consider enabling a small burst pool of pre-warmed GPU instances for emergency use. Will put a proposal on the ops board.

samuel.cho: thanks everyone. I'll keep monitoring traffic for the next 2 hours.

infra-oncall: keeping ASG at desired 18 for now. Will revert after stability window or after we automate LT fix.

mira.kapoor: marking incident as "mitigated" in the incident tracker. Will update with RCA draft once we have logs from CA + AWS change history. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: ASG activity completed, 16 InService, 2 NotReady (one reprovisioning).

jen.walsh: quick note — we should also notify platform-security about the deleted instance-profile so they can check for accidental removals in prior rotations.

mira.kapoor: agreed, looping them in. Thanks all for quick responses.

pagerduty-bot: incident closed to P2 monitoring by oncall-manager.

mira.kapoor: final: postmortem scheduled, customer outreach going out, running root cause investigation now. Will attach logs and timeline to the incident doc."
